75505e58e2b8e13c0addf0084a6457a68d983bca: A resort on a human scale, Beuil-les-Launes focuses on the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than on impressive figures. Its 30 km of runs are well suited to a stay of 3 to 4 days, especially with family or for skiers who don't need to constantly change their playground. Beuil-les-Launes' family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Southern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. The moderate altitude of Beuil-les-Launes, starting at 1400 m and reaching 1800 m at the top, makes it sensitive to climate variations. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. Outside that window, checking the snow reports before setting off is strongly advised. At €37 for a day lift pass, Beuil-les-Launes sits in the mid-range for cost: neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and its facilities justifies the price for most skiers. In short, Beuil-les-Launes is one of the rare resorts that combines a real village, a sincere family atmosphere and runs suited to everyone. It would be hard to have a bad stay here.
